messages:
Maria: FYI — CloudPartner reported 502s against Dedicated GPU pool at 07:42 PT. Seems intermittent but hitting production customers.
Ajay: thanks — what's the impact? errors rate / customers affected?
Maria: ~4% requests failing, 2 customers on marketplace. Latency still fine when successful. Logs point at model-loading timeouts on node pool A.
Sophie: @maria can you open a partner war room channel? we should follow the partner escalation flow rather than standard oncall bridge since marketplace listing involved.
Maria: proposing channel name: #partner-warroom-cloudpartner-07-11
Kevin: prefer shorthand: #pw-cloudpartner-07-11 so it's easier to type in alerts. also add the marketplace rep and their SRE.
Maria: ok switching to #pw-cloudpartner-07-11. I'll create and invite: @ajay @sophie @kevin @marketplace-rep @cloudpartner-oncall
Maria: /invite @marketplace-rep @cloudpartner-oncall @support-bot
oncall-bot: Created channel #pw-cloudpartner-07-11 · pinned: partner-sev-template
Ajay: War room checklist (quick):
- Confirm customer impact & active sessions
- Snapshot node pool and model variants
- Switch routing to compatible variant if capacity issue
- Notification: Marketplace PM + account team
Sophie: add rollback path:
1) set model -> fallback-quantized
2) route new requests to pool B
3) drain pool A
Kevin: who owns initial bridge ops? I can be bridge lead for first 30m then hand to @cloudpartner-oncall
Maria: perfect. @ajay can you run sampling to confirm model load errors? sample command:
```
redwood logs --service=dedicated-pool-A --filter="model_load_error" --since=15m
```
Ajay: on it. sharing logs in channel.
Ajay: found repeated "OOM while allocating kv-cache" from node 3, model beacon-13B-ptq
Sophie: kv cache OOM suggests quantization mismatch — we should try smaller batch or route to beacon-7B variant.
Maria: action items:
- Kevin = bridge lead (0-30m)
- cloudpartner-oncall = partner liaison
- Ajay = infra investigator
- Sophie = model fallback lead
- Maria = comms (notify PMs + docs)
Kevin: I'll post a status update every 10m to #partnerships and escalate to execs if >60m
Maria: Template status update:
"STATUS: SEV (partner) — CloudPartner — impact: marketplace customers experiencing 502s — mitigation: routing to beacon-7B started — ETA for stabilized routing: 12m — bridge lead: Kevin"
Sophie: also enable verbose model metrics and increase trace retention for this incident (3h) so E2E traceback possible.
Ajay: confirmed ops change: routing rule added, pool A drained, errors dropped to 0.6%. Continuing to monitor.
Maria: tentatively closing war room at T+45 if stable. I'll post postmortem request link here: https://redwood.internal/pmr/SEV-partner-cloudpartner-07-11
oncall-bot: Reminder: create postmortem in 24h · template: partner-sev-postmortem
Kevin: thumbs for closure, will leave channel open for 2h for any regressions :thumbsup:
cloudpartner-oncall: Thanks team — we can confirm customers report recovery. We'll follow up on root cause with our infra team.
Maria: thanks all, excellent quick ops. I'll capture notes and next steps in the PMR.
